title: Hydrolyse an ester, then oxidise the liberated alcohol
title_de: Ester hydrolysieren und den freigesetzten Alkohol oxidieren
question: Can two requested transformations conserve the two-carbon fragments of a four-carbon ester?
script:
# MO-003: Hydrolyse an ester, then oxidise the liberated alcohol
# Design only: predictions below are not measured observations.
register lv3
add v1 water 100mL
seal v1 250mL
add v1 ethyl_acetate 0.001mol
add v1 NaOH 0.001mol
react v1 saponification
inspect v1
add v1 O2 0.002mol
react v1 alcohol-oxidation
measure v1 ph
inspect
expected_result: Successful sequential transformations first yield acetate and ethanol, then convert the ethanol fraction into another acetate/acetic-acid family pool. Carbon accounting should retain four carbons per initial ester molecule.
